reference_format.note: HS/<type>/YY/NNNNN, with the case type in the second segment (FA, PR, CD seen in one fortnight).

quirks.summary: keyVal is not the usual uppercase alphanumeric token: it reads like '_HSTBC_DCAPR_123308', with a leading underscore and underscores inside.
quirks.detail: A keyVal grep of [A-Z0-9]+ matches nothing, so a search that returned results reads as having returned none. The 2026-09-16 survey recorded 'returned nothing' here, most likely for this reason.
quirks.workaround: Match keyVal=([^&"'\s]+), i.e. everything up to the next separator.

robots.note: Two requests for robots.txt were closed by the server without a response, while the portal pages answered normally, so its content is unknown.

pacing.note: Five requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (idox-public-access)
Advanced search worked but returned nothing for 1-31 July 2026; not a retrieval failure. Retry with a wider window.
